question: What is MDLOps used for in the KOTOR toolchain?
answer:
MDLOps converts and inspects KotOR MDL/MDX model assets for modding: you can decompile models to ASCII, edit meshes and nodes, and rebuild binaries for in-game use [1]. It sits alongside MDLEdit and Blender pipelines when authors need reliable MDL round-trips without breaking animations [2].

Sources
[1] https://github.com/ndixUR/MDLOps
[2] https://kotor.neocities.org/tutorials/mdlops
